+class _AiohttpResponse:
+    def __init__(self, body: bytes, headers: dict, status: int):
+        self.content = body
+        self.text = body.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
+        self.headers = headers
+        self.status = status
+
+    def raise_for_status(self) -> None:
+        if self.status >= 400:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'HTTP {self.status}')
+
+
+class _AiohttpSessionAdapter:
+    def _proxy_url(self, proxies) -> str | None:
+        if not proxies:
+            return None
+        return proxies.get('https') or proxies.get('http')
+
+    def _request(self, method: str, url: str, *, verify=True, proxies=None, **kwargs) -> _AiohttpResponse:
+        async def _runner() -> _AiohttpResponse:
+            timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=None)
+            proxy_url = self._proxy_url(proxies)
+            async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:
+                request = getattr(session, method)
+                async with request(url, ssl=verify, proxy=proxy_url, **kwargs) as response:
+                    body = await response.read()
+                    return _AiohttpResponse(body, dict(response.headers), response.status)
+
+        return asyncio.run(_runner())
+
+    def get(self, url: str, *, verify=True, proxies=None, **kwargs) -> _AiohttpResponse:
+        return self._request('get', url, verify=verify, proxies=proxies, **kwargs)
+
+    def post(self, url: str, *, verify=True, proxies=None, **kwargs) -> _AiohttpResponse:
+        return self._request('post', url, verify=verify, proxies=proxies, **kwargs)
+
+
